title: Rust: Rule 5 compression
description: Implement Rule 5 OSCORE compression in Rust. Acceptance: compresses OSCORE, passes same vectors as Python.
notes: Implemented strict Rust Rule 5 OSCORE compression selection in rust/lichen-schc/src/codec.rs and focused acceptance tests in rust/lichen-schc/tests/rule5_compression.rs. The scanner now validates CoAP token bounds, option extended delta/length bounds, exactly one Object-Security option, RFC8613 value flags/PIV/context/KID structure, duplicate options, and non-empty payload-marker semantics before selecting Rule 5; malformed/non-OSCORE input remains on plaintext Rule 0, matching the Python oracle. Evidence: canonical oscore_linklocal shared vector exact bytes; valid empty/PIV/context/KID forms; malformed/truncated/duplicate rejection from Rule 5; exact 22554-byte profile boundary and one-over rejection; undersized output error. Validation passed: cargo fmt --package lichen-schc -- --check; cargo check -p lichen-schc --no-default-features; cargo test -p lichen-schc --lib --test rule5_compression --test shared_vectors => 71 + 6 + 3 passed; cargo clippy with the same scoped targets and -D warnings passed. Unqualified cargo test -p lichen-schc is currently blocked only by another worker's untracked tests/link_layer_integration.rs being compiled without required std/schnorr features (12 unresolved gated API errors); active workers confirmed they do not own codec.rs, and existing dirty codec hunks were disjoint RPL work preserved intact.
close_reason: Rust Rule 5 compression matches canonical Python/shared vectors with strict malformed and boundary coverage
